source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of antiviral and antiretroviral drugs (PDF 212) with the book's box and an original diagram.

blocks.text: Antiviral dawaen virus se hone wale infections ka ilaaj karti hain. Yeh jism ke andar viruses ki growth aur afzaish (multiplication) rokti hain. Yeh dawaen bohat se viruses ke khilaf kaam kar sakti hain, jin mein hepatitis, influenza aur herpes viruses shamil hain.

Antiretroviral dawaen retroviruses se hone wali bimariyon ke ilaaj ke liye banayi gayi hain, jin mein HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) shamil hai. Yeh immune system ke difa (defense) mein madad karti hain aur HIV ko barhne (proliferate karne) se rokti hain. Retroviruses woh viruses hain jin ka genetic maadda RNA hota hai aur jo reverse transcriptase enzyme ki madad se apni nakal (replication) banate hain.
Tamam antiretroviral dawaen antiviral hain, lekin tamam antiviral dawaen antiretroviral nahi.
blocks.title: Kitab ka box

blocks.alt: Bara neela daira 'Antiviral drugs' (hepatitis, influenza, herpes viruses) aur us ke andar chhota surkh daira 'Antiretroviral drugs' (retroviruses, e.g. HIV).
blocks.caption: Sab antiretroviral dawaen antiviral hain, lekin sab antiviral antiretroviral nahi (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.text: Bara daira tamam antiviral dawaen hain; chhota daira, jo us ke andar hai, antiretroviral dawaen hain. Chhota daira poora bare ke andar hai, is liye har antiretroviral antiviral hai, magar bare daire ki baqi dawaen (maslan influenza ya herpes ki) antiretroviral nahi.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.prompt: Antiviral aur antiretroviral dawaon mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Antiviral dawaen aam taur par viruses (jaise hepatitis, influenza, herpes) ke khilaf hain. Antiretroviral dawaen khaas taur par retroviruses, jaise HIV, ke khilaf hain jo RNA rakhte aur reverse transcriptase istemal karte hain. Har antiretroviral antiviral hai, lekin har antiviral antiretroviral nahi.

items: Antivirals: viruses ki growth aur afzaish rokti hain (hepatitis, influenza, herpes).
Antiretrovirals: HIV jaise retroviruses (RNA, reverse transcriptase) ke khilaf.
Sab antiretrovirals antivirals hain, sab antivirals antiretrovirals nahi.
